title: VERIFY T-446: forge, tamper and expire tokens; no signing path
acceptance_criteria: Replay every falsifier. Generate a key as an agent would and try to sign a token set with it: verify must refuse.
Read the module for any path that signs, holds a shared secret, or trusts a key named inside the token file instead of the enrolled root.
In throwaway copies: skip the expiry check; skip the agent match; verify against any key the file names. Each mutant must make at least one test fail.
Run the full suite via goal_mode, then verdict.

notes.note:
VERIFIED (role=verifier task IS the review step, P-022). This is the formal record of the T-446 verdict performed above.

Bullet 1 (generate a key as an agent would, try to sign, verify must refuse): covered by shipped Falsifiers::test_a_set_signed_by_a_non_root_key_is_refused plus my own independent probe in round 1's rejection (fresh ed25519 key, signed, refused with SIGNATURE DOES NOT VERIFY) -- re-confirmed still passing in the full-suite replay.

Bullet 2 (read the module for any signing/shared-secret/payload-named-key path): ast-walked dispatch_token.py, no string constant 'sign' anywhere, no HMAC/shared-secret construct; _verify_file_signature (lines 236-270) sources the allowed signer exclusively from w.trust_dir(root)/root.pub, never from the payload, in the shipped file -- confirmed by direct read, independent of the producer's own static-read claim.

Bullet 3 (three mutants: skip expiry, skip agent match, verify against any key the file names -- each must make >=1 test fail): all three now caught. Expiry-skip and agent/task/role-match-skip were caught in round 1 (Falsifiers::test_an_expired_token_is_refused, ::test_a_token_for_worker_a_presented_as_worker_b_is_refused) and remain caught. The payload-named-key mutant -- the one gap I found in round 1 -- is now caught by the new Falsifiers::test_a_payload_that_names_its_own_signer_as_trusted_is_still_refused, independently reconfirmed: I built my OWN mutant (not the producer's copy) in a scratchpad-only throwaway .harness/bin copy, patched _verify_file_signature to trust a trusted_signer_pubkey field from the payload and drop the fingerprint cross-check, ran the real unmodified test file against it with -k names_its_own_signer -> FAILED (AssertionError: TrustError not raised), confirming the pin is real.

Bullet 4 (full suite via goal_mode, then verdict): python3 .harness/bin/goal_mode.py run --cmd "python3 -m pytest .harness/tests -q" run twice independently -> GOAL REACHED (iter 2/3, 130.87s) and GOAL REACHED (iter 3/3, 126.87s), both exit 0; direct python3 -m pytest .harness/tests -q -> 1066 passed, 4 skipped in 130.67s. Verdict recorded on T-446 (status=done) with producer worker-g10-token != approver harness-verifier, handoff chain confirmed in blackboard.json.

Mutants never touched the live tree: all three built/run only in a scratchpad tempdir copy of .harness/bin, never committed, live .harness/trust and ~/.ssh/harness_root untouched.
